title: Minimal insights cardset + cost telemetry slice (MVP scope cut)
creator: Sofia Martinez
description:
Context: After stakeholder review and capacity constraints for Q2 delivery, we need to narrow the initial Console Insights surface to a minimal, reliable set of dashboard cards and telemetry that delivers high signal for latency/cost troubleshooting without delaying launch. This ticket captures the scope reductions, acceptance criteria, and follow-up work for trimmed features.

Goals:
- Ship a compact insights landing surface that covers route-level latency and cost trends, basic trace sampling overview, and token-level cost is deferred.
- Keep performance and engineering effort bounded: single API for the minimal tile payloads, no heavy trace flamegraph rendering in MVP.

Out of scope for MVP (explicit cuts):
- Per-token cost breakdowns and tokenized cost attribution (deferred to a later iteration).
- Full trace flamegraph and waterfall drilldown (only top-level spans and sampled traces included).
- Multi-card cross-filtering and ad-hoc query builder (deferred).

Why: The risk assessment showed token-level costs and flamegraphs add significant backend compute and frontend complexity that threatens the 2025-Q2 ship date. Prioritizing route-level rollups and a compact cardset preserves customer value for cost/latency triage while enabling faster rollout and lower operational cost.
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Insights landing page displays a maximum of 4 summary cards: Route Latency Trend, Route Success Rate, Route Cost Trend (route-level aggregated), and Alerts summary.
AC-2: Each summary card returns within 350ms P95 for the default 7d range under staging load (defined load: 200 requests/min simulated).
AC-3: Cost Trend card shows daily total cost per route and highlights top 5 contributing routes with percent change (no per-token detail).
AC-4: Tracing surface provides: sampled traces list (max 10) and a single-span overview for each trace; no interactive flamegraph or span waterfall in MVP.
AC-5: Backend exposes one compact insights API (GET /insights/landing) returning payloads for the 4 cards; payload schema documented and accepted by SDK/console teams.
AC-6: Rollout gating: feature flag exists and can be enabled per-organization; canary rollout tested for 10 customers without regressions to existing telemetry endpoints.
AC-7: Metadata and dashboards include basic instrumentation: per-request latency buckets, route identifier, cost category label; quality tests validate 99% of events contain required metadata.
decisions: D-1: Cut per-token cost attribution from MVP; prioritize route-level aggregation to reduce storage and query cost.
D-2: Replace full flamegraph tracing with a sampled-trace list + single-span summary to reduce frontend complexity and backend trace indexing load.
D-3: Limit default time window to 7 days for the landing page to keep query latency predictable; longer ranges can be added post-MVP.
D-4: Implement an insights-specific read model (pre-aggregated daily rollups) rather than ad-hoc long-tail queries for MVP to meet latency SLOs.
tradeoffs: T-1: User power vs. ship time: losing per-token cost and deep flamegraphs reduces investigative granularity but substantially lowers build and infra effort.
T-2: Aggregated rollups improve latency and cost predictability but mean certain correlation queries will require follow-up engineering or export tooling.
T-3: Keeping a single compact API simplifies console integration but reduces future flexibility for ad-hoc visualization; we document extension points in the API contract.
progress_updates: 2025-03-12: Initial triage meeting (PM, Eng infra, Console FE). Agreed to pursue scope cuts to meet Q2 ship window. Action: PM to produce trimmed acceptance criteria.
2025-03-14: Engineering scoping review — backend favors pre-aggregated daily rollups; estimated 5 story points for core API + rollups. Console FE proposes simplified card designs (mock links below).
2025-03-16: Security sign-off requested for telemetry schema (no PII expected). Feature flag gating added to rollout plan. Asked Eng for a canary backlog item.
2025-03-18: Design review complete; cards consolidated to 4. Draft API contract posted. Ready for In Review with Console FE + Infra.
